message.mechanical.fire_pit.roast_skin: Skin it first: hide, wool or feathers would burn
message.mechanical.tripod.big_middle: On a big Fire Pit the Tripod stands over the middle
message.mechanical.casting.full: The casting table holds %s Gold Ingots
message.mechanical.casting.needs_kiln: The gold needs a Clay Kiln at %s° beside the table to melt
message.mechanical.jewelers_bench.needs: Lay a Gold Ring Blank or Gold Chain and a cut gem on the bench, then set it with a chisel
message.mechanical.jewelers_bench.occupi: There is already one on the bench
chat.mechanical.road.marker: Set this marker down where you want the road to end, at most %s blocks from our camp. Up to %s blocks we build it for nothing; beyond that, one Silver Coin for every %s blocks.
chat.mechanical.road.need_silver: A trade road that long costs %s Silver Coins (a Gold Coin is worth 10). Come back with the coin.
chat.mechanical.road.upgrade: Good. We will widen the road and tread it hard, wide enough for traders and carts.
message.mechanical.road.no_camp: The %s have no camp to build a road from any more
message.mechanical.road.bad_spot: Set the Road Marker on firm ground with room above it
message.mechanical.road.busy: The %s are already building a road
message.mechanical.road.too_far: %s blocks from their camp: too far (at most %s)
message.mechanical.road.need_silver: This road costs %s Silver Coins (a Gold Coin counts as 10)
message.mechanical.road.placed: The %s will build a road to here: %s blocks from their camp, for %s Silver Coins
message.mechanical.road.blocked: The road builders of the %s found no way on: the road ends where they got to
dialog.mechanical.tribe.leader: Welcome to the camp of the %s. If our people are friends, a road between our fires would serve us both.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.oak_g: The Mother feeds us all. Take only what you need.
Where a berry is picked, a bush is planted.
Mind the glowcaps, they light the night for the old ones.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.oak_w: Older than the hills, and she still grows.
Sit a while. Breathe with her.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.oak_l: No night falls on the Mother while we walk.
Keep your fire far from her roots.
Round and round, till the stars go out.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.oak_k: Speak, traveller. The Oak has tasks for those who listen.
Bring what the forest asks, and the forest gives back.
Your tribe's deeds are remembered here, good and ill.
chat.mechanical.oak_folk.harm: Stay your hand! You wound the Mother Oak!
message.mechanical.oak_quest.done: The Keeper is pleased: %s is done.
gui.mechanical.oak_quests.closed: The Keeper turns away. "You have harmed the Mother and her children. There is nothing more for you here."
gui.mechanical.oak_quests.all_done: "Every task is done. The Mother remembers your tribe."
quest.mechanical.oak.berries.story: The roots are thirsty after the long cold. Bring the red berries of the thicket, so the Mother may taste summer again.
quest.mechanical.oak.mushrooms.story: Under the moss the Mother hides her gold. Gather chanterelles in the shade of the old trees and bring them here.
quest.mechanical.oak.fibre.story: At midsummer our wreaths hang from every branch. Twist plant fibre for their threads, as much as your hands can carry.
quest.mechanical.oak.bark.story: Our healers burn oak bark when the fevers come. Bring strips of it, and the sick will breathe easier.
quest.mechanical.oak.hides.story: Winter bites the little ones first. Bring raw hides from the hunt, so none of our children sleep cold.
quest.mechanical.oak.sinew.story: Our watchers need strong bowstrings. Bring sinew from the beasts you take, and waste nothing of their gift.
quest.mechanical.oak.antlers.story: The deer lay down their crowns in the forest. Find them before the snow returns and lay them at the roots.
quest.mechanical.oak.bronze.story: You have learned to marry copper and tin. Show the Mother this bright metal, so she knows what your tribe has become.
quest.mechanical.oak.bear.story: The great bear wears a coat fit for a keeper. Face it with honour, and bring its pelt to the Oak.
quest.mechanical.oak.iron.story: Red water runs in the bogs, and from it your smiths draw iron. Bring it worked and hammered, and we will speak of older things.
quest.mechanical.oak.giant_antler.story: Far away the Great Stag still walks. Bring its crown, and your hunt will be sung under these branches for an age.
quest.mechanical.oak.steel.story: The ritual blade must be made of the hardest metal men know. Bring steel, and the last gift of the Oak is yours.
message.mechanical.signal_horn.heard: A Signal Horn sounds to the %s, %s blocks away
message.mechanical.signal_horn.tribe: %s blows the Signal Horn to the %s, %s blocks away
message.mechanical.camel.shies: The camel shies away. Crouch and hold out feed
message.mechanical.camel.trust: The camel eats from your hand (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.camel.ready_for_halte: It trusts you now. Put a Rope Halter on it
message.mechanical.camel.needs_halter: Put a Rope Halter on it before feeding it more
message.mechanical.camel.refuses_halter: The camel won't take the halter yet. Feed it first
message.mechanical.camel.haltered: Haltered. Keep feeding it to tame it (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.camel.tamed: The camel is tame. Ride it, give it Pack Baskets, or hitch it to a Cart. It goes far without water
message.mechanical.fennec.shies: The fennec bolts. Crouch and hold out meat
message.mechanical.fennec.trust: The fennec takes the meat from your hand (%s/%s)
message.mechanical.fennec.tamed: The fennec is yours. Its great ears will warn you of what comes in the night
message.mechanical.fennec.warns: Your fennec yips and stares into the dark: %s
message.mechanical.knife_too_weak_hide: This hide is too tough for your knife
message.mechanical.heavy.wont_budge: It won't budge: it takes %s to move it at all (%s holding on)
message.mechanical.elkwight_axe.heavy: Far too heavy to lift. Sneak + right-click to take hold of the haft: it takes two
message.mechanical.leech.latched: A leech has latched onto your leg
message.mechanical.huldra.accept: You take her gift. The forest feels kind tonight.
message.mechanical.huldra.refuse: You turn away... and the trees all look the same.
message.mechanical.wisp.astray: The light goes out. Where is the path?
message.mechanical.tomte.not_yule: He does not touch it. It is not Yule.
message.mechanical.tomte.fed: The Yule porridge is gone. Someone is pleased.
message.mechanical.tomte.angry: Something small and grey glares at you.
message.mechanical.nacken.fiddle: A fiddle plays down by the rapids...
message.mechanical.nacken.again: He has taught you already this year.
message.mechanical.nacken.lesson: Näcken plays for you alone, and you understand.
message.mechanical.dune_wraith.stole: A cold breath of sand... and your water is gone.
message.mechanical.dune_wraith.touch: Sand brushes past you and is gone.
message.mechanical.bergtagen: You wake in the dark, deep inside the mountain. Small grey shapes watch you.
message.mechanical.blood_kettle.not_full: Not full yet: %s / %s mB. A bucket takes a full kettle
dialog.mechanical.tribe.caravan.woodsman: Well met! The %s bring timber goods down from the great forests: saplings of every tree, good axes and saws, resin and bark. Everything for coin, and we pay for good cordage and glue.
dialog.mechanical.tribe.caravan.mining: Ho there! The %s carry what a miner needs: picks, torches, lamps, coal and good ore from the deep veins. Got raw ore of your own? We buy it.
dialog.mechanical.tribe.caravan.jewelry: Peace be with you! The %s have crossed the sands with gold and stones for the great and the wise. And if you have gemstones... ah, gemstones! I pay well, in silver and gold.
dialog.mechanical.tribe.caravan.hunting: Greetings, hunter! The %s trade in bows and arrows, spears and snares, and the finest furs of the north. Bring us raw pelts, horn and claw, and we pay in coin.
dialog.mechanical.tribe.caravan.herbs: Be well, friend! The %s gather what heals and helps: salves and poultices, honey, berries of the juniper and seeds to sow. We buy good mushrooms and the beaver's musk.
dialog.mechanical.tribe.caravan.foraging: Good day! The %s live off the land and bring its gifts: baskets and seed bags, nuts, dried berries and good cord. Full baskets of berries we always buy.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.handl: Easy, easy... they spook at strangers.
Don't touch the animals. Talk to the old one if you want to trade.
Long road behind us. Let them graze a while.
message.mechanical.caravan.animal: The caravan's animal: its guards would not like that
gui.mechanical.caravan.purse_empty: Their purse can't pay for it
gui.mechanical.caravan.none_to_sell: You don't have enough of it
mechanical.configuration.blendEdges.tool: Related neighbouring blocks (ground, stone, planks) fray into each other on their top faces instead of meeting in a straight seam
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.root.d: Bare hands. Pick up Loose Rocks and Loose Flint lying on the ground
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.plant_: Break grass and ferns for Plant Fibre (a knife triples the yield)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.flint_: Craft a Flint Knife from Flint, Twine and a Stick. It stays in the grid as a tool
Craft a Flint Axe (2x2, fits the inventory grid). Logs need an axe
Craft a Flint Pickaxe. It also knaps rocks into stone tool heads
Craft a Flint Shovel or a Flint Hoe
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.firewo: Chop a tree with an axe: its logs split into Firewood
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark.d: Hold right-click with an axe on a felled tree's log to hew a block off it: its Bark comes first, one kind per wood (tinder, bast, baskets, roofs)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.haul_l: Right-click an end of a felled tree with an empty hand and carry it off: the other end drags, or a friend lifts it. Over 12 blocks it takes Leads at the root end
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark_c: Collect the Bark of all 19 woods, from Oak to Yew: each wood's felled logs give their own
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark_b: Craft a Bark Basket for berries, mushrooms and hides. Food keeps longer inside
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark_r: Craft a Bark Roof from 3 Bark of one wood. Against a wall it lies as a slope, on top of a block it lies flat
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.tool_r: Put a knife above any Log in the crafting grid to carve a Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.walkin: Lash two Tool Rods together with Twine into a Walking Staff, like the caravan traders carry
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.elders: Crown a Walking Staff with a Bone and two Feathers: an Elder's Staff
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pine_r: Right-click a Pine Log with a knife for Pine Resin. Resin over a Stick makes 2 Torches
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.stone_: Knap 3 rock chunks with the Flint Pickaxe into a Stone Pickaxe Head or Stone Axe Head
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.double: Knap two heads together with the Flint Pickaxe between them
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.tool_s: Build a Tool Station from a Flint Axe and a Flint Pickaxe. It joins head, binding and shaft
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.crude_: Tool Station: stone head + Twine + Stick makes a Crude Stone Pickaxe or Axe
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.stone_: Tool Station: Double Stone Pickaxe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod
Tool Station: Double Stone Axe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.fire_d: Craft a Fire Drill from Twine and Sticks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.woodpi: Right-click the top of a solid block with Firewood to stack a pile, up to 3 blocks high. Any wood stacks on, mixed; an empty hand takes a piece back
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.log_pi: Right-click the ground with a Rough Log to start a log pile, any woods mixed. Round logs roll off a tall, narrow pile: build it wider to build it higher, or between walls
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.campfi: Build a Campfire from Sticks and 3 Firewood. It is placed unlit
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.light_: Right-click an unlit Campfire with the Fire Drill. Leaf Litter or Bark as tinder first helps it catch
Fires leave soot. Tool Station: Straw + Twine + Tool Rod makes a Broom; each sweep thins soot in a 3x3 by one stage
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.fire_p: Ring a Firewood with 8 rock chunks into a Fire Pit, set it on a flat 2x2 of ground and light it with the Fire Drill. Big light, big smoke, bigger raids
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.kiln.d: Craft a Clay Kiln (Clay Balls, rock chunks) and place it on a Campfire. Burn it 2 min at 500° before use
Bake a Clay Ball into a Brick in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.charco: Bake a Log or 2 Firewood into Charcoal in the kiln. The hottest fuel
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.clay_b: Shape 3 Clay Balls into an Unfired Clay Bucket and fire it in the kiln. It only carries water
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.mold_b: Craft a Mold Bench from Flint, a Clay block and Planks. Crucibles and clay molds are shaped there from Clay Balls
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.mold_c: Craft a Mold Chest from Planks and Clay Balls: 27 slots that only take molds, from a hopper too
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.crucib: Shape an Unfired Crucible (7 Clay Balls) at the Mold Bench, fire it in the kiln at 800°: needs Charcoal or Bellows. The key to bronze
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.log_ra: Lash 6 logs together with 3 Cordage into a Log Raft
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.paddle: Carve a Rough Log into a Paddle with a knife
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.dugout: Mark a felled log with a knife, then work it: axe, fire, axe, fire, axe, knife
Pick up Loose Red Ochre (badlands, savanna), Yellow Ochre (desert, rivers) or Chalk (shores, hills)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pigmen: Grind ochre, chalk or Charcoal with the Flint Pickaxe in the grid, or on a Stone Anvil
Mix 2 pigment with Tallow or water in a Bowl
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.cave_p: Paint in the off hand, right-click a wall with a Paintbrush (Stick + 2 Plant Fibre). Sneak to pick a motif
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.beaten: Walk the same way over grass a few dozen times until it wears into a Trodden Path. Paths are faster to walk on
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.feedin: Craft a Feeding Trough (5 Planks) and fill it with a water bucket or fodder. Penned animals with no grass to graze or no water get tired and won't breed. Troughs side by side join into one
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.nettle: Cut Stinging Nettle in forests and on riverbanks for Nettle Stalks. It stings bare legs: wear leggings or sneak through
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.drop_s: Craft a Drop Spindle: a Stick over a whorl of rock, Bone or Clay. It stays in the grid as a tool
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.spun_t: Strip Nettle Stalks into Nettle Fiber with a knife, then spin it with the Drop Spindle into Nettle Thread
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.sinew_: Split Sinew from a butchered animal with a knife into Sinew Thread: it sews Leather like any other thread
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.found_: Press G by a Fire Pit and found a tribe: the pit becomes its centre and can't be broken. Members share their advancements
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.grow_t: Invite another player into your tribe from the tribe page (G)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.revive: A tribe mate is down: sneak and hold right-click on them, carry them to a safe place and hold R to bring them back
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.second: Go down and be brought back by a tribe mate, with two hearts and everything you carried
Mine Slate with a Flint Pickaxe, mostly in cold windswept hills and peaks. Polish it, then craft Slate Bricks into Slate Tiles: a roof that doesn't burn
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.gneiss: Mine banded Gneiss with a Bronze Pickaxe (flint only scratches it), mostly under mountains: Smooth Gneiss, Gneiss Bricks, mossy and cracked
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.chalk_: Press 4 Chalk into a Chalk Block, or find chalk beds near the surface by beaches and plains. Broken, it crumbles back into 4 Chalk
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.soapst: Mine soft grey-green Soapstone with a Flint Pickaxe, mostly under mountains, and craft it into Polished Soapstone and Soapstone Bricks
Mine dark Shale with a Flint Pickaxe, low down under plains, swamps and rivers, and craft it into Polished Shale and Shale Bricks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.conglo: Mine pebbly Conglomerate with a Flint Pickaxe in river banks, and craft it into Polished Conglomerate and Conglomerate Bricks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pumice: Mine light, porous Pumice with a Flint Pickaxe: deep down near lava (y -30 to 20), and higher up under the badlands
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.scoria: Mine red-black Scoria with a Flint Pickaxe: deep down near lava (y -30 to 20), and higher up under the badlands
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.jasper: Mine red-brown Jasper Stone with a Flint Pickaxe, mostly under badlands and deserts (y 50 to 100), and craft Jasper Bricks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.gypsum: Mine chalky Gypsum with a Flint Pickaxe under deserts and badlands (y 40 to 90), and cut it into Cut Gypsum
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.alum_s: Mine near-black Alum Shale with a Flint Pickaxe, deep under cold taiga and snowy lands (y -30 to 40)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pumice: Crush Pumice on the Stone Anvil into a Pumice Chunk and right-click rough stone with it: Soapstone, Andesite, Tuff ... come out polished, no bronze needed. A chunk polishes 16 blocks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.beach_: Dig Beach Pebbles with a shovel on stony shores, shingle beaches and basalt coasts, or mix 2 Gravel and 2 Loose Stones. Slabs make a pebble floor
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.fields: Pick up Fieldstone lying on moraines and shingle (any pickaxe), or put 4 Loose Stones together. Six make 6 Dry Stone Wall: no mortar needed
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.peat.d: Dig Peat with a shovel at the bottom of ponds and streams in swamps and taigas. It burns twice as long as firewood on a campfire and three minutes in the Clay Kiln; 4 Peat make 4 Peat Bricks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.dried_: Cut a Peat block into 4 Cut Peat and dry them on a Drying Rack outdoors by day. Each Dried Peat burns as long as a firewood and as hot, so a block of peat gives twice the fire once dried
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bog_oa: Dig out a black Bog Oak trunk buried in the ground of swamps and taigas (y 55-62): a whole wood set without a tree
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.turf.d: Bind Dirt with Plant Fibre into Turf, and cut it into slabs and stairs for a turf roof
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.dirt_s: Craft 3 Dirt into 6 Dirt Slabs. Grass grows onto them, a shovel flattens them into path slabs, and they get snow like a Grass Block
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.soft_s: Dig up a half step from a natural slope: hills, beaches and snowfields now have slabs on every 1-block step, so you, animals and carts walk up without jumping. Or craft Dirt, Sand and Coarse Dirt Stairs
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.stone_: Pick up a loose rock of one of the new stones (Slate, Marble, Porphyry ...) where it comes up. It knaps like any rock, and 4 make its block
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.reed_t: Cut Reed by rivers and swamps (it grows like sugar cane), dry it on a Drying Rack and lay the Dried Reed as Reed Thatch or a sloped Reed Thatch Roof. It burns easily
Find Mudstone on river banks in deserts, savannas and badlands and craft it into Adobe Bricks, or mix Clay, Sand and Straw into Wet Adobe Bricks and dry them on a Drying Rack: 4 Adobe Bricks make 4 blocks
Dig pale Loess under the grass of plains and savannas. Tilled with a hoe it is the richest farmland; 4 make Loess Bricks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.rammed: Ram Dirt or Loess, Gravel and a Clay Ball into 2 Rammed Earth: cheap, thick walls
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.wattle: Weave sticks into Wattle, then daub it with 2 Clay Balls, Straw or Plant Fibre and Manure. Two sticks frame it as timber
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.ochre_: Press 4 Red or Yellow Ochre into a block, or dig ochre beds in clay banks, rivers, savannas and badlands. Broken, it gives the 4 back
Make a knife. Kill an animal and right-click its Carcass with the knife to butcher it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.butch: Butcher a Carcass with a knife: hides and feathers first, then meat scraps
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pluck: Pluck a Greylag Goose carcass with a knife, then take the Plucked Goose with an empty hand or cut it into Raw Goose
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bird_: Build a Bird Nest from Sticks and Straw near geese, pheasants, ptarmigans, rock doves or chickens: they claim it and lay in it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.scrap: Scrape a Raw Hide with a knife in the crafting grid
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.dryin: Build a Drying Rack and right-click it with a Scraped Hide
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leath: Take the dry Leather off the Drying Rack after about 3 minutes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.five_: Take five different dried things off a Drying Rack: leather, jerky, dried berries, Adobe Bricks, Dried Peat, Dried Reed, Dried Kelp...
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve Fish Bones, a Bone or a Horn into a Bone Needle with a knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leath: Craft a Leatherworking Bench from Leather, a Bone Needle, Planks and a Crafting Table
Sew Leather and thread (wool, nettle, linen or sinew) into Leather armor at the Leatherworking Bench
Sew 4 Leather into a Leather Satchel: 9 slots that go with you
Tie a Leather Pouch: Cordage over Leather. 4 slots, worn at the hip in place of a quiver (B opens it)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.worn_: Put the Leather Satchel in the Back slot next to your player in the inventory, then press B to open it anywhere
Wear a cloak (Otter Fur Cape, Ermine Mantle or Glider Cloak) in the Cloak slot: warmth and armor over your armor
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.travo: Lash 4 Tool Rods, 2 Cordage and a Scraped Hide into a Travois to drag big carcasses home
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.many_: Drag a big carcass together with a friend: both sneak + right-click it with an empty hand. Two pull faster than one
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.movin: Drag a Woolly Mammoth carcass home with four hunters. Fewer can only strain at it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.hangi: Build a Hanging Rack (5 Tool Rods, Cordage) and hang a carried carcass on it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.prime: Butcher a carcass on the Hanging Rack: double meat as Haunch, Ribs and Loin
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snare: Set a Snare (2 Sticks, Cordage) where small game walks. Bait it with berries or seeds
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fishi: Fish with a Crude Fishing Rod (Tool Station: Flint + Twine + Tool Rod) or a Fish Trap
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fish_: Craft a Fish Trap (6 Sticks, 2 Twine) and place it in open water, best in rivers
Gut a Whole fish with a knife in the crafting grid for fish and Fish Bones
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve a Bone Fish Hook, then Tool Station: hook + Twine + Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.flint: Tool Station: Flint + Cordage + Tool Rod. Sprint and hold right-click to charge
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.crude: Tool Station: Cordage + Twine + Tool Rod makes a Crude Bow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.arrow: Right-click a Fletching Table: Flint or bone + Stick + Feather makes 4 arrows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.sinew: Fletching Table: Sinew + Crude Bow + Cordage. Full arrow damage
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tallo: Cook Lard (Wild Boar) or Bear Fat on a Campfire into Tallow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.candl: Craft Twine and 2 Tallow into Candles, light them with the Fire Drill
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.quive: Sew a Quiver at the Leatherworking Bench (2 Leather, thread) and wear it in the Hip slot: bows shoot from it, picked-up arrows go in
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tusk_: Butcher a Wild Boar for a Tusk. Tool Station: Tusk + Cordage + Leather makes a Tusk Dagger
Kill a Brown Bear and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger (or bronze knife) for its pelt, fat and claws
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bear_: Dry the Raw Bear Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day (it takes the whole rack)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fur_a: Sew Bear Pelt and Sinew into Fur armor at the Armor Station. Each piece blocks 25 % of the cold
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.deep_: Go below Y 0. Caves get colder the deeper you go and freeze you near the bottom: wear furs and light a fire
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bear_: Craft a Bear Pelt and a Bear Claw into a Bear Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.barbe: Fletching Table: Bear Claw + Stick + Feather
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.raw_w: Kill a Grey Wolf (they hunt at night and fear fire) and butcher it for a Raw Wolf Pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wolf_: Dry the Raw Wolf Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day
Sew 2 Wolf Pelts and Sinew into a Wolf Hood at the Armor Station
Sew Wolf Pelts and Sinew into a Wolf Fur Coat, Leggings or Boots
Craft 2 Wolf Pelts and a Bone into a Wolf Rug. A pelt on a Straw Bed makes a warm Furred Straw Bed
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.phant: Kill a Phantom yourself and butcher it for Raw Phantom Hide
Scrape the hide and dry it on a Drying Rack, in daylight only
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.glide: Craft 4 Tool Rods, 2 Bones, Sinew and Cordage into a Glider Frame
Sew 6 Phantom Leather and the Glider Frame into a Glider Cloak at the Armor Station
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ancie: Find the great hollow oak. Trails lead to it from the villages
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.giant: Bring down the rare, keen-eyed Giant Deer for its Giant Antler. It charges anyone who hurts it and rams down the tree you climb
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mythi: Offer the Giant Antler on the Offering Altar inside the Ancient Oak
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.oak_f: Speak with the Keeper of the Oak Folk, crowned with giant deer antlers. Harm the tree or its people and they turn on you
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.oak_q: Finish a quest for the Keeper. Your whole tribe shares the quest line
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.verda: Earn the Verdant Staff from the Keeper. Right-click plants with it to make them grow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ancie: Finish the Keeper's last quest for the Ancient Ritual Knife, the finest knife there is
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ritua: Butcher with the Ancient Ritual Knife: only it takes the Animal Heart, Fine Sinew and Trophy Skull
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.undea: Kill a Brute: the rare huge zombie in a bearskin cape, slow but tough and hard to knock back
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.spear: Kill a skeleton charging with a Flint Spear. Now and then it drops the spear
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tribe: Palisade
Find a Tribe Village. Stay on good terms: camps that burn for days draw raiders
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.beave: Hunt a Beaver by a forest stream or lake and butcher it for its pelt, tail, castoreum and teeth
Find a Beaver Dam across a forest creek and stand on it: beavers fell small trees, gnaw the logs and dam narrow streams
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.log_b: Walk across a log bridge: a tree fallen over a creek in the woods, resting on both banks
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pelt_: Lace a Raw Beaver or Otter Pelt into a Stretching Hoop (4 Sticks, Twine) and let it cure outdoors by day
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.water: Make a Beaver Fur Hat or an Otter Fur Cape: warm, and they keep off the chill of rain and water
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.beave: Set a Beaver Tooth in a stick with Twine: a sharp little knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.casto: Mix Castoreum, Tallow and Bark into Castoreum Salve: heals and draws out poison. Castoreum also baits snares
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.otter: Hunt an Otter along a river or rocky shore. Watch your drying fish: otters are thieves
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mosqu: Swat a Mosquito Swarm. On warm evenings in the fens they come for you; smoke and fire drive them off
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bison: Butcher a Steppe Bison for its hide and the hunters' prize, the tongue. A panicked herd stampedes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pegge: A big raw hide (Bison, Musk Ox, Rhino, Mammoth) is too big for a rack: place it on the ground to peg it out, let it cure in the sun
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.giant: Make a Bison, Musk Ox or Mammoth Rug from its cured hide
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.qiviu: Butcher a Musk Ox for Qiviut, its fine underwool. Threatened, the herd closes into a ring around its calves
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.rhino: Hunt a Woolly Rhinoceros for its horn. Hurt it and it charges: step aside, and it may stun itself on a tree
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.hide_: Stretch a cured Rhino Hide over planks into a Shield
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.rhino: Lash a Rhino Horn onto a Tool Rod with Cordage: a slow, heavy club
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mammo: Bring down a Woolly Mammoth and butcher it (Tusk Dagger or better) for its Ivory. The herd's matriarch warns once, then charges
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ivory: Craft an Ivory Knife from Mammoth Ivory (with Cordage and Leather) or Walrus Ivory: a skinning knife that can cut bears
Carve Mammoth Ivory into an Ivory Figurine with a knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mammo: Render Mammoth Fat into Tallow on a Campfire (3 per piece)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lek_h: Stalk a singing Capercaillie cock at dawn (step in while he grinds, he hears nothing then) and pluck him for his Tail Feathers
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.great: Bag a Great Bustard on the open plains: it runs from you long before you are close. Pluck it for a big bird's worth of meat
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.owl_f: Bring down an Eagle-Owl as it hunts the forest at night, for its soft Owl Feathers
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.silen: Fletch Silent Arrows with Owl Feathers at the Fletching Table: a miss lands without a sound and startles nothing
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.eagle: Bring down a Golden Eagle (it may steal your small game!) for Eagle Feathers and Talons
Fletch Eagle-Fletched Arrows: the hardest-hitting flint arrows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.raven: Bind three Raven Feathers to a Bone with Twine. Carried, the dark wears on your mind more slowly
Sneak up on a Seal on a cold shore before it slips into the water, and butcher it for Raw Sealskin and Blubber
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.seals: Dry the Raw Sealskin on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day
Sew Sealskin and Sinew into a Sealskin Parka or Boots at the Armor Station: warm, and they keep out the chill of the water
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.oil_l: Craft an Oil Lamp (rock chunks, Plant Fibre), fill it with Blubber and light it with the Fire Drill
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.walru: Kill a Walrus on the frozen sea (it fights back) and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger or better for Ivory, Blubber and hide
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ivory: Craft Walrus Ivory, Twine and a Stick into an Ivory Knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.walru: Dry the Raw Walrus Hide on a tall Drying Rack (it takes the whole rack). A knife cuts it into 6 Cordage
Sew 2 Walrus Hide and Sinew into a Walrus Hide Cuirass at the Armor Station
Catch a Pike in a river, fen or swamp: on the hook, or sneak up and spear it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.sturg: Spear one of the rare giant Sturgeons in a river and butcher it, or hook a young one, for its roe and Isinglass
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lemmi: Catch a Lemming on the snowy plains, in a Snare or by hand. Every eighth day they swarm
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ermin: Skin an Ermine and cure its Raw Ermine Pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 6 Ermine Fur, Leather and Sinew into an Ermine Mantle: warm as fur and easy to enchant
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.marte: Hunt a Pine Marten (it runs up trees and robs bird nests) and cure its pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 5 Marten Fur and Sinew into a warm Marten Fur Cap
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wolve: Kill a Wolverine (it stands its ground and steals carcasses and snare bait) and skin it
Trim a Fur Hood with 2 cured Wolverine Fur and Sinew: frost never clings to it, no more freezing
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.claw_: Lash 2 Wolverine Claws, a Stick and Sinew into a skinning knife: more pelt and hide off every carcass
Kill a Lynx. It stalks lone wanderers at night: company, fire and torches keep it off
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lynx_: Cure 2 Lynx Pelts on a Drying Rack and craft them with a Bone into a Lynx Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.polar: Kill a Polar Bear (it stalks seals at the ice edge, and people too) and cure its pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 2 Polar Bear Pelts, Leather and Sinew into a Polar Bear Cloak, the warmest thing you can wear
Craft a Polar Bear Pelt and a Bone into a Polar Bear Rug
Too Much of a Good Thing
Butcher a Polar Bear and keep its liver. The old hunters never ate it: it poisons
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.arcti: Hunt an Arctic Fox (it trails polar bears for their leftovers) and cure its pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 3 Arctic Fox Fur and Sinew into a warm Arctic Fox Hat
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snow_: Find the rare Snow Leopard on the highest peaks, bring it down and cure its pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 2 Snow Leopard Pelts and Sinew onto Leather Boots: a fall of a few blocks no longer hurts
Craft 2 Snow Leopard Pelts and a Bone into a Snow Leopard Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snowy: Bring down a Snowy Owl, the owl that hunts lemmings by day on the snow, for its feathers: they fletch Silent Arrows too
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.black: Hunt a Black Grouse (in spring the cocks lek at dawn on the bog) for its Lyre Feathers: 6 arrows each
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Find Bone Marrow where a Lammergeier dropped a bone on the rocks to crack it (it takes bones and Bone Piles)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lamme: Bring down a Lammergeier for its feathers: they fletch Eagle-Fletched Arrows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pika_: Take Pika Hay from a pika's hay pile on the high slopes (they make hay in summer and autumn): fodder, or 9 for a Hay Bale
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wild_: Hunt the shy, night-prowling Wild Cat of forest edges and meadows and skin it for its pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wildc: Flesh the pelt with a knife, then craft 2 Wildcat Pelts and Sinew into a Wildcat Fur Cap
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.moles: Catch a Mole: snare its runs, or dig up a fresh molehill to flush it out. Flesh its pelt into Moleskin
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.field: Catch a Field Vole, the pest that nibbles crops and raids chests by the fields at night
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snake: Butcher an Adder or a Grass Snake for Snakeskin
Craft Leather Boots, 2 Snakeskin and Sinew into Snakeskin Boots: an adder can't bite through them
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.venom: Kill an Adder, the viper of heaths and sunny meadows, and butcher it for its Venom Gland
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.poiso: Craft 8 arrows around a Venom Gland into Arrows of Poison
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snake: Bind a Venom Gland, Lard and Plant Fibre into Snakebite Poultices. Eating one cures poison
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pluck: Bring down a Mute Swan and pluck it: Down, a Swan Quill and a big Plucked Swan. Keep clear of its nest
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.down_: Pluck Down from a Mallard or Mute Swan. Laid in an unlit campfire, Fire Pit or kiln it is the best tinder
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.heron: Butcher a Grey Heron for its Heron Bill: a knife carves it into 2 Bone Fish Hooks
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.plume: Make a Plume Headdress from Heron Plumes, Down and Leather: herons and cranes let you come close
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve a Hollow Bird Bone (swan, crane) or a Vulture Wing Bone into a Bone Flute. Playing it lifts the spirits around you
Get close to an Ibex on the peaks (it flees uphill, up the rock face) and butcher it for its Horns and pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.horn_: Fletching Table: 2 Sinew + Sinew Bow + 2 Ibex Horns makes the Horn Bow: its arrows fly faster and hit harder
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fat_t: Work a raw Ibex, Saiga or Hyena pelt or a Raw Chamois Hide with a knife and fat (Tallow, Lard, Bear or Marmot Fat) in the grid
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.chamo: Sew 3 Chamois Leather and Sinew into Chamois Boots at the Armor Station: long falls hurt less
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.marmo: Catch a Marmot before its whistle sends the colony - and every animal around - running
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.saiga: Bring down a Saiga, the most skittish game of the steppe (take a bow), and take its amber horns
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.horn_: Set Saiga Horns in a lattice of sticks: Horn Windows let the light in
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.cave_: Cave Bear
Wake a Cave Bear in its den under the mountains, survive, and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger or better: its skull is your trophy
Ice Age Fur
Dry the Raw Cave Bear Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day (it takes the whole rack)
Laughing Thieves
Kill a Cave Hyena - they steal carcasses and harass you at night in packs - for its fangs and spotted pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.giant: Kill a Giant Centipede in the dark below Y 0 - it clings to cave ceilings and drops on you - and butcher it for chitin, fangs and venom
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.chiti: Sew 7 Centipede Chitin and Sinew into a Chitin Vest: a chestplate long before bronze
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.centi: Ring a Centipede Venom Sac with 8 Arrows for 8 Arrows of Poison, or bind it with Lard and Plant Fibre into Snakebite Poultice
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.vittr: Kill a Vittra below Y 0 - it hunts by sound: mining and sprinting call it, torchlight keeps it off - and butcher it for hide and eyes
Sew 5 Vittra Hide into a Vittra Hood: no vittra hears you through it
Put a Vittra Eye in a Glass Bottle: a Potion of Night Vision
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.troll: Kill a Troll below Y -30 - it shuns torchlight - and butcher it with a tusk-grade knife for its hide, hair and tusks
Lure a Troll out under the open sky by day: it turns to stone. Mine a Troll Stone
Sew 7 Troll Hide and Sinew into a Trollhide Coat
Bind a Troll Tusk to a stick with Twine: a skinning knife that cuts the thickest hides
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lindw: Slay a Lindworm in the deepest dark below Y -45 - fast, armoured, venomous - and claim the hoard it lay on
Bind two Lindworm Fangs to a stick: the Lindworm Fang Blade
Eat the Lindworm Heart: its strength becomes yours
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.torto: Butcher a Tortoise. Pulled into its shell it shrugs off most blows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.shell: Bind a Tortoise Shell with gravel inside onto a stick: held in hand it keeps predators off like a torch
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lizar: Grab at a Desert Lizard: it sheds its tail and escapes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.water: Bring down a Water Buffalo (its whole herd will charge you) and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger or better
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leopa: Kill a Leopard. It sleeps up in the trees by day and drops on its prey at dusk
Fat-tan 2 Raw Leopard Pelts with a knife and Tallow or Lard, then craft them with a Bone into a Leopard Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.jungl: Pluck a Peacock for its eyed feathers, or a Hornbill for its casque
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tiger: Kill a Tiger. Creeping through the thicket it can't be seen until it is almost upon you
Fat-tan 2 Raw Tiger Pelts with a knife and Tallow or Lard, then craft them with a Bone into a Tiger Rug
Sew 2 Tiger Pelts and 2 Sinew into a Tiger Pelt Mantle and wear it in the Cloak slot
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pytho: Butcher a Python. It drops from the branches and squeezes until someone strikes it loose
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.orang: Butcher an Orangutan, the ape that pelts you with fruit and steals what you leave lying about
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.saltw: Kill a Saltwater Crocodile, the still log in the mangrove water, and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger or better
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.croco: Fat-tan a Crocodile Hide and sew a piece of Crocodile Hide armour at the Leatherworking Bench
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.blowp: Make a Blowpipe from 3 Bamboo and puff Darts (Bamboo and a Feather) at your quarry
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.poiso: Tip Darts with the poison of a Poison Dart Frog (or a Venom Gland). Don't touch the frog with bare hands
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mud_d: Catch a Mudskipper or a Fiddler Crab out on the mangrove mud, before it skips away or ducks into its hole
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.cave_: Pale Dweller
Catch a Cave Salamander in a dark cave lake: pale, blind and wholly aquatic. Move slowly - it feels the water stir
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.dark_: Put a Cave Salamander and Glow Lichen in a Bowl: Dark-Sight Broth, Night Vision for 3 minutes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.blind: Catch a Blind Cave Fish: cast a line into a lake deep in a cave, out of the sky
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bat_s: Strike down a Bat Swarm as it pours out of a cave mouth at dusk. Where the bats come out, there is a cave
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.caver: Kill a Cavern Spider in the shallow caves - mind its great webs across the narrow passages - and butcher it for silk and fangs
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.cave_: Spinner's Trap
Cut a Cave Web whole with a knife or shears and set it as a trap: whatever walks in is held fast
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.hyena: Butcher a Spotted Hyena. By day the packs drag off any kill you leave lying and trail wounded animals
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.cheet: Bring down a Cheetah: the fastest sprinter of all, but it gives up after five seconds, and it shies from people
Fat-tan 2 Raw Cheetah Pelts and sew them with Sinew and Leather into a Cheetah Cloak for the Cloak slot
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.signa: Hollow a Gazelle Horn with a knife and bind it with Sinew: a Signal Horn heard 256 blocks away
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ostri: Pluck an Ostrich, or pick up the egg an ostrich hen laid. Corner one and it kicks
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.termi: Poke a Stick into a Termite Mound on the savanna until it comes out covered in Termites
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.chiti: Pound 4 Termites into Chitin Paste: a glue that does what Hide Glue does
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.scorp: Butcher a Desert Scorpion for its venom. It hides by day and stings at night; 8 arrows round the venom make Arrows of Poison
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tame_: Crouch with raw meat and win over a Fennec Fox at night. Tamed, it yips and marks whatever creeps up in the dark
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.viper: Butcher a Sand Viper. It lies buried in the sand and bites whoever steps near it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.rattl: Butcher a Rattlesnake for its rattle. It always rattles before it strikes: back off
Kill a Puma. It lies up on the badland ledges by day and leaps down on whatever passes below
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.puma_: Fat-tan 2 Raw Puma Pelts with a knife and a tanning fat, then craft them with a Bone into a Puma Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bigho: Butcher a Bighorn ram for its great horn (careful: hurt, it charges). One horn makes a Horn Bow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.condo: Bring down a Condor, the great carrion bird circling high over the badlands, for its flight feathers
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fox_d: At night red foxes raid farms for eggs and hens. Follow the paw prints to the Fox Den: your eggs lie there
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fox_f: Hunt a red fox and cure its pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 5 Fox Fur and Sinew into a warm Fox Fur Hat
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wisen: Bring down a Wisent, the giant of the broadleaf woods: peaceful, but any grown one fights back, and it charges if you crowd it
Fat-tan a Raw Wisent Hide with a knife and Tallow or Lard, with a Bone, into a Wisent Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pond_: Catch a Pond Turtle sunning itself on a log in the fen before it slips into the water. Its shell makes bowls
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.beetl: Find a Giant Stag Beetle in the dark forest. Its glossy shell grinds into brown dye and black pigment
Follow a woodpecker's drumming to a rotten Grub Log and dig out the Grubs: bait for snares
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.deadw: Find a snag in the woods, a dead tree gone silver-grey with its bark only at the foot, and take a block of its Deadwood
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.shelf: Break a Shelf Fungus off the trunk of a dead tree
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wild_: Take Wild Honey from a Bumblebee Nest in the meadow in spring or summer. Sneak, or they may sting
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leech: Wade in a fen until a leech latches on. When it drops off sated keep it: laid on the skin it draws out poison
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.whole: Leave a Fish Trap in a river or fen overnight: eels come out in the dark
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.crayf: Set a Fish Trap in a river or fen in Reaping, the last month of summer, and it fills with crayfish
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tribe: Guests at the Fire
Keep your camp fire burning for 3 days and a tribe comes to see who you are. Right-click their leader to talk and trade
Their Land
Walk into the land of another tribe: a village, a camp or another player tribe's Fire Pit. Their name and your standing show on screen
A Night by the Fire
When the leader asks at dusk, let the band stay the night. At dawn they leave you a gift
Neighbours
A tribe you hosted settles nearby and builds a camp of hide tents. Its traders walk over to you
Walls of Their Own
A neighbouring camp gathers enough wood, stone and hides to grow, and raises a palisade
Best of Friends
Reach a standing of 80 with a tribe: trade with them, bring them food, let them stay by your fire
Meat for the Pot
Put a carcass down at the camp of a tribe that likes you (Neutral or better): a generous gift. Bigger game pleases them more. Below Neutral they take it as a threat
Paths Between Us
At Friendly or better, ask a neighbouring camp's leader or trader for a road and set the Road Marker down where it should end. Their folk walk out and build it, with steps where the ground climbs
The Trade Road
At a standing of 60, have a tribe widen a finished road into a broad, well-trodden trade road. Their camp then stays loaded, so their traders walk it even when nobody is near
Sleeping Camp
Come upon tribespeople at night: they lay out Straw Beds round the fire and sleep while their warriors keep watch. By day they sit round the fire whittling, eating and talking
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.carav: Talk to the old leader of a Trader Caravan: a handler with the animals, a laden cart and guards in armour, now and then near your camp as the Wandering Trader once was. Each caravan deals in one kind of goods, for coin
Sell a gemstone to a jewelry caravan: they love gems and pay in silver and gold
Meet a caravan of every kind: Timber & Tools, Mining Equipment, Jewelry & Gemstones, Hunting Gear & Furs, Herbs & Remedies and Forager's Goods
Meet a big caravan: a Wagon drawn by a pair, rarer goods at dearer prices and a fuller purse
Buy the last of something from a caravan. Their goods run out and are not restocked, and they only buy while their purse lasts
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.miner: Trade with a Miner, a rare wanderer of the caves below Y 30, hunched under his ore sack. He sells the ores missing nearby
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tribe: Peoples of the World
Walk into a Tribe Village in each climate: turf and bone huts in the snow, bark-roofed halls in the woods, mud brick on the savanna and in the desert, stilt houses in the jungle and swamps
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.cave_: Limestone Caverns
Find Limestone Caverns at middle depth under temperate land: limestone walls, travertine pools and thin stalactites
Salt Caves
Find the Salt Caves under hot, dry land: white gypsum walls hung with Rock Salt
Ochre Caves
Find the Ochre Caves just below warm, dry land: red and yellow ochre in chalk, and paintings older than any tribe
Soapstone Grottos
Find the Soapstone Grottos under cold land. Someone hid tools here once: look for their chests
Glowworm Caves
Find the Glowworm Caves under humid woods, lit faint blue by Glowworms on the ceiling
Ice Caves
Find the Ice Caves under the frozen lands: packed and blue ice in slate
Peat Hollows
Find the Peat Hollows just below cool, wet land, where Bog Oak roots hang from the peat
Bone Caves
Find the Bone Caves, the dens of cave bears and hyenas, littered with bones. Bring a spear
Flooded Caves
Find the Flooded Caves under the coasts: clay, gravel and water everywhere
Galena Seams
Find the Galena Seams deep down: shale and black alum shale, rich in galena
Magma Vents
Find the Magma Vents near the bottom of the world under hot lands: basalt, scoria, magma and lava
Crystal Geodes
Find the rare Crystal Geodes deep in the rock: quartzite caves full of gem crystals
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.cold_: Leave food in a chest or barrel in the Ice Caves (or with ice right beside it) and open it again: in near-freezing air food spoils at a quarter of the speed, in cool air at half
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.magma: The Magma Vents' air overheats you: you tire, and above 19 on the thermometer you burn. Cool off in water there
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.night: Grind 2 Bat Wings with Soot and Lard into Night-Eye Salve. Rub it under your eyes to see in the dark
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.giant: Live through a Giant Deer's charge. When it lowers its head and stomps, jump aside
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.first: Live to see winter. Lakes freeze, snow falls where it rained, and the cold bites: wear fur and keep a fire burning
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.throu: Be there when winter turns to spring. Stock food before the cold comes: little grows and less is found in winter
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.full_: Be there when a new year begins (1 Thaw)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.white: Stand out in a snowstorm: a thunderstorm in winter snows hard and drifts snow deep, even under the trees
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.rude_: Wake a bear from its winter sleep. Bears hibernate in a den all winter, and a woken bear is an angry one
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.crane: See the migratory birds back in spring. Cranes, Grey Herons, Geese and Mute Swans fly south in late autumn
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.chalk: Find the Chalk Downs: open grass on white Chalk near the coast, flint lying in the turf, hares and sheep
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.peat_: Find a Peat Bog in the cool taiga: Peat under the moss, dark pools, Bog Iron in the pool floors, buried Bog Oak, Reed and cranes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.slate: Find the Slate Highlands: cold windswept hills with Slate on every slope, Gneiss beneath, heather, mouflon and eagles
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.soaps: Find the rare Soapstone Valley in the temperate windswept forests: grey-green Soapstone lies in the open, soft enough for flint
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.limes: Find a Limestone Karst: bare limestone pavement with thin grass and flowers, dry sinkholes, Travertine in the pools
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.marbl: Find a Marble Gorge on the warm plateaus: white Marble cliffs and Limestone. Marble needs a Bronze Pickaxe
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ochre: Find the Ochre Badlands: cliffs striped with Red and Yellow Ochre, Gypsum and Mudstone. Loose ochre lies on the red sand
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.basal: Find a Basalt Coast: black Coastal Basalt columns standing in the sea, Beach Pebbles between them, seals on the rocks
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.shing: Find a Shingle Beach on a cool coast: Beach Pebbles over gravel, loose Fieldstone and great glacial boulders
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.reed_: Find a Reed Delta where swamp meets the coast: dense Reed beds, mud banks, Clay, Loess and Mudstone, ducks and swans
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.glaci: Find a Glacial Moraine in the cold taiga: gravel ridges, Conglomerate, Fieldstone and boulders of Gneiss and Granite left by the ice
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.gypsu: Find the Gypsum Flats in the driest desert: a white crust of Gypsum and Rock Salt, Alabaster below
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mammo: Find the Mammoth Steppe in the cold, dry north: dry grass on Loess, mammoths, rhinos, bison, wild horses and saiga, and the lions that hunt them
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.packe: Dig up Packed Sand from a wind-packed flat in the desert or on a beach, Packed Red Sand in the badlands, or Packed Snow from a scoured patch on a snowy slope. Tribe trade roads are trodden into the same ground
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.into_: Travel more than 2500 blocks from the world's centre and find the rare Scorched Barrens: a burnt forest of Charred Logs and Wood Ash, ravens overhead
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.after: Pick Fireweed, the first flower to come up through the ash of the Scorched Barrens. Plants take root in Burnt Soil again
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.roof_: Climb a mountain peak above Y 250. The highest ranges far inland rise to nearly Y 290
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.under: Stand beneath a natural rock arch. Wind and frost wear them out of the rock in the hills, the karst and the badlands; they are rare
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.old_b: Find the bones of a long-dead animal and stand among them: on the plains and the steppe, half buried in the desert sand, or mammoth tusks in the Loess
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.burnt: Step into an Elkwight ruin in the Scorched Barrens: a Blackstone arena with glowing Rune Blackstone, thick with dark fog while its master lives
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.windt: See a thunderstorm bring down a tall tree. Its trunk is left lying as a fallen log, and within a week or so it has rotted into moss and podzol with a sapling beside it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.from_: Stand in a young forest that grew back where a wildfire burned. Dry summer lightning lights the woods; the ash turns to soil, Fireweed comes first, then grass, flowers and birch saplings, and after a few seasons young trees stand
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.high_: Wade into a spring flood. When the snow melts, late in Snowmelt, creeks and rivers rise a block over their flat banks for a few days, and leave clay, gravel and driftwood behind when they go down
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.elkwi: Far out in the Scorched Barrens, kill the Elkwight waiting in a burnt ruin. Every attack is shown first: learn the signs
Drag the Elkwight's axe home - it takes two - and stand it up as a trophy: right-click the top of a block while you hold it
Drag the Elkwight's colossal body with three others. One can't move it, two barely can
Skin the Elkwight - only a knife past steel cuts that hide - and sew 2 Elkwight Hide, 2 Sinew and Cordage into an Elkwight Cloak
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve a Bone Charm from 3 Elkwight Bones, Cordage and a Gold Nugget. Worn in the Charm slot: two more hearts
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.elkwi: Hang the Elkwight Antler Crown on a wall
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.gloso: Kill a Gloson - the grey sow that circles you in the dark with glowing eyes and charges - and cut the Razor Ridge off its back
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.razor: Lash a Razor Ridge to a Stick with Sinew: a Razor Knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.brist: Bind Gloson Bristles to a Stick: a Paintbrush
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.spore: Kill a Mushroom Man before it swells and bursts into spores, and take its Spore Sac
Wrap a Spore Sac in a Puffball: a Spore Bomb to throw
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.funga: Lay Mushroom Flesh as tinder in an unlit fire: it catches like dry bark
advancements.mechanical.food.root.title: Food & Farming
advancements.mechanical.food.root.descri: Pick wild berries, mushrooms or nuts. Fresh food spoils: raw meat in 1 day, berries in 2
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked.desc: Cook meat on a lit Campfire. Take it off with an empty hand before it burns
advancements.mechanical.food.burnt.title: Overdone
advancements.mechanical.food.burnt.descr: Leave food on the Campfire too long
advancements.mechanical.food.roasted.des: Roast mushrooms, hazelnuts or beechnuts on a Campfire
Boil an egg on the Campfire, then peel it in the crafting grid
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_bird: Cook Raw Goose, Pheasant, Ptarmigan or Pigeon on a Campfire, or roast a whole Plucked bird
advancements.mechanical.food.beaver_tail: Roast a Beaver Tail on the Campfire: fatty, rich and filling
advancements.mechanical.food.nest_egg.de: Take an egg from a wild Bird Nest (by rivers, in forests, on snow or bare rock). Leave one, or the birds may abandon it
advancements.mechanical.food.smoking_rac: Build a Smoking Rack (Sticks, Cordage) over or beside a burning Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.smoked.desc: Hang raw meat or fish on the Smoking Rack for 4 minutes. Keeps 30 days
advancements.mechanical.food.dried.title: Sun-Dried
advancements.mechanical.food.dried.descr: Put raw meat, fish, berries or mushrooms on a Drying Rack outdoors by day (faster in full sun). Keeps 30 days
advancements.mechanical.food.three_kinds: Take three different dried meats or fish off a Drying Rack: venison, beef, fowl, stockfish... Big cuts must be sliced into strips first
advancements.mechanical.food.spoiled.des: Let food spoil. A Bark Basket or a sealed Storage Jar slows it down
Cut Wild Einkorn or Wild Emmer with a knife, or pick Wild Peas
advancements.mechanical.food.sow.title: Sower
advancements.mechanical.food.sow.descrip: Till soil with a hoe and sow grain or peas on the farmland
advancements.mechanical.food.sheaf.title: Harvest
advancements.mechanical.food.sheaf.descr: Harvest a ripe crop for a Sheaf. A sickle gives bonus sheaves and Straw
advancements.mechanical.food.crop_stakes: Craft Crop Stakes (Sticks, Twine) and put them on farmland: the crop grows 25% faster, and a right-click on it ripe harvests and replants it
advancements.mechanical.food.flail.title: Threshing
advancements.mechanical.food.flail.descr: Hold sheaves in the off hand and right-click a hard surface with a Flail for grain and Straw
advancements.mechanical.food.straw_bed.d: Craft a Straw Bed (3 Straw, 3 Planks) and right-click it to rest: sets spawn, keeps Phantoms away
advancements.mechanical.food.slept_in_st: Lie down in a Straw Bed at night. Once every player is lying down, the night runs fast till morning
advancements.mechanical.food.porridge.de: Mix 2 Grain, a Clay Water Bucket and a Bowl, then cook it on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.square_meal: Eat Porridge, Bread, Broth or a Stew. Prepared meals keep you full far longer than raw food
advancements.mechanical.food.wild_carrot: Dig up a Wild Carrot (white flower umbels on meadows and plains). A knife or sickle gets the whole root
advancements.mechanical.food.carrot.desc: Sow Wild Carrots on farmland. Now and then a ripe harvest gives a real Carrot
advancements.mechanical.food.sea_beet.de: Cut Sea Beet on a beach or stony shore: Sea Beet Leaves and sometimes Beetroot Seeds
advancements.mechanical.food.potato.desc: Potatoes don't grow wild here. A few tribe elders trade seed potatoes for Leather and an Antler
advancements.mechanical.food.root_cellar: Build a Root Cellar (Planks, Straw) and dig it into the ground: roots keep 4x longer, other food 2x
advancements.mechanical.food.manure.desc: Pick up Manure that livestock drop. Right-click farmland with it: fertility +2
advancements.mechanical.food.compost.des: Build a Compost Heap (Sticks, Leaf Litter, a copper ingot) and fill it with plant waste
advancements.mechanical.food.scarecrow.d: Build a Scarecrow (copper ingot bell, Carved Pumpkin, Straw, Raw Hide) to keep crows off the crops
advancements.mechanical.food.flour.title: Grind
advancements.mechanical.food.flour.descr: Build a Quern (Cobblestone, Stick, copper ingot axle) and grind Grain into Flour
advancements.mechanical.food.dough.title: Dough
advancements.mechanical.food.dough.descr: Mix 2 Flour and a Clay Water Bucket into Dough
advancements.mechanical.food.bread.title: Daily Bread
advancements.mechanical.food.bread.descr: Bake Dough on a Baking Stone beside a Campfire, or in the kiln at 200°
advancements.mechanical.food.hearty_stew: Simmer 4 or more ingredients in a Bronze Kettle of water over a fire, then ladle the stew out with a Bowl
advancements.mechanical.food.blood_sausa: Mix a Blood Bucket with 2 Flour and Lard into Raw Blood Sausage, then cook it on a Campfire
Cook Mammoth, Rhino, Bison or Musk Ox meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.bison_tongu: Roast a Bison Tongue on a Campfire: the most filling cut of all
advancements.mechanical.food.forest_fowl: Cook Raw Capercaillie or Raw Bustard on a Campfire, or roast a whole Plucked one
advancements.mechanical.food.ground_nest: Take an egg from a Capercaillie nest on the pine-forest floor or a Great Bustard nest out in the grass
advancements.mechanical.food.sea_meat.de: Cook Seal or Walrus meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.caviar.desc: Take the roe from a Sturgeon: little food, but very filling
Cook the meat of a Lynx, Wolverine, Pine Marten, Ermine or Lemming on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.arctic_fare: Cook Polar Bear, Arctic Fox, Snow Leopard, Pika or Black Grouse meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.bone_marrow: Eat Bone Marrow, cracked out of a bone a Lammergeier dropped: rich and filling
Roast Wildcat Meat, a Mole, a Vole or Snake Meat on the Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_wate: Cook Raw Mallard, Swan, Heron or Crane on a Campfire, or roast the whole Plucked bird
advancements.mechanical.food.swan_egg.de: Take an egg from a Mute Swan's nest without getting chased off
advancements.mechanical.food.mountain_me: Cook Ibex, Chamois, Marmot, Saiga, Cave Bear or Hyena meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.marmot_salv: Mix 2 Marmot Fat with Juniper Berries into Marmot Salve: rub it on to heal
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_cent: Cook a Raw Centipede on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_folk: Cook the meat of a Vittra, a Troll or a Lindworm on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.warm_fare.d: Cook the meat of an Onager, Tortoise, Water Buffalo, Tapir or Leopard, or a Lizard Tail, on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.jungle_fowl: Pick up an egg a Jungle Fowl hen laid. Throw it: it may hatch a chick
advancements.mechanical.food.mangrove_fa: Cook Tiger, Python, Orangutan, Monitor, Crocodile or Monkey meat, a Mudskipper or Crab Meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.deep_fare.d: Cook a Blind Cave Fish or roast a Spider Leg on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.ostrich_egg: Roast an Ostrich Egg whole on a Campfire and eat it
advancements.mechanical.food.desert_fare: Cook Camel Meat, Bighorn Mutton, Puma Meat, a Fennec or a Scorpion on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.temperate_f: Cook Wisent, Pond Turtle, Water Vole, Eel or Crayfish on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.meadow_bird: Cook a Skylark, a Lapwing or a Bittern on a Campfire, or roast one whole
advancements.mechanical.food.meadow_nest: Take an egg from a Skylark or Lapwing nest hidden in the grass of the plains
Feed a burning Campfire Peat or Dried Peat and smoke meat or fish over it: the thick peat smoke cures twice as fast as wood
advancements.mechanical.food.guano.title: Bat Droppings
advancements.mechanical.food.guano.descr: Scrape Guano from under a bat roost in a cave. Right-click farmland with it: poor soil turns rich at once
advancements.mechanical.food.soot_fertil: Scrape Soot off a sooty ceiling and right-click farmland with it: fertility +1, like Compost
advancements.mechanical.food.winter_berr: Pick Lingonberries or Juniper Berries in winter. Other berry bushes freeze and give nothing until spring
advancements.mechanical.food.thicket_ber: Pick Sloes, Sea Buckthorn Berries or Jujubes from a thorny thicket. Each grows in its own climate, and ripens in autumn
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_elde: Raw Elderberries make you sick. Cook them on a Campfire into Cooked Elderberries
advancements.mechanical.food.wildflowers: Pick a wild flower of the open lands: they bloom only in their season, and are plain leaves the rest of the year
advancements.mechanical.food.fallow_seas: Sneak-click a crop with an empty hand in winter: nothing grows in the fields until spring, so harvest and store before
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_glos: Cook Raw Gloson on a Campfire
Look for green Malachite or Native Copper among loose rocks: copper ore lies below
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.raw_c: Mine Copper Ore with a stone pickaxe for Raw Copper
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.pan.d: Craft a Pan from Planks and Twine
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.panni: Right-click Gravel or Sand with the Pan, then hold right-click in water for Cassiterite and copper
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.stone: Craft a Stone Anvil from rock chunks and Cobblestone, with the Flint Pickaxe
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.crush: Put ore on the Stone Anvil and strike it 4 times with a pickaxe as hammerstone
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.conce: Hold an empty Pan and crushed ore in the other hand, use it in water. Worth double in the crucible
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tuyer: Shape 3 Clay Balls into an Unfired Clay Tuyere and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bello: Craft Bellows, set it facing the kiln's firebox and pump it: +40° per click
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.molds: Shape a mold from Clay Balls at the Mold Bench and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.molte: Click copper ore onto a Crucible and melt it in the kiln: copper needs 1085°
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coppe: Pour the molten crucible into a Clay Ingot Mold within 60 s
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rough: Pour molten copper into a tool head mold and take out the Rough Cast head
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.whets: Build a Whetstone from Sandstone, Sticks and Planks
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.sharp: Right-click the Whetstone 4 times with a Rough Cast head
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coppe: Tool Station: Copper Pickaxe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod. It mines Tin Ore
Assemble a Copper Axe, Shovel, Hoe or Knife at the Tool Station
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tin.d: Mine Tin Ore with the Copper Pickaxe and crush the Cassiterite on the Stone Anvil
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Bronze!
Melt about 9 parts copper and 1 part tin in a Crucible at 950° and cast it
Bronze Pickaxe
Cast, sharpen and assemble a Bronze Pickaxe. It mines Iron Ore
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.raw_i: Mine Iron Ore with a Bronze Pickaxe. The Iron Age awaits
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Bronzesmith
Assemble a Bronze Axe, Shovel, Hoe or Knife (the knife can butcher bears)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.writt: Cut Sugar Cane into Paper with a Bronze Knife, bind a Book with Leather, and make a Book and Quill with Soot Ink (2 Soot + Tallow or Lard) and a Feather
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Bronze Blade
Fire spear or sword molds, cast and sharpen, then assemble a Bronze Spear or Bronze Sword
Bronze Tips
Shape a Clay Arrowheads Mold (3 Clay Balls), cast bronze in it, grind the sprue into 4 Bronze Arrowheads and fletch Bronze Arrows: 3 damage, seldom break
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.armor: Cast and sharpen a Bronze Plate, then build an Armor Station from 2 Bronze Plates, a Bronze Ingot, Planks and a Crafting Table
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Bronze Plate
Rivet Bronze Plates onto Leather with a pickaxe or hammer at the Armor Station: a Bronze Helmet or Greaves
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.furna: Shape Clay Balls and Sand into Unfired Furnace Bricks, fire them in the kiln (600°) and put 4 together
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.smelt: Build 3x3x3 Furnace Bricks with only the middle empty, a Furnace Chute on top, a Furnace Tap mid-bottom front. Throw ore and Charcoal onto the chute, light it
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tap_m: Sneak-use the tap to open it: molten metal fills Clay Channels downhill and runs into a Clay Mold. A quarter more metal per ore
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.scoop: Use an empty Crucible on a Clay Channel with metal in it to scoop it out. Channels laid down a one-block step slope like rails
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.kettl: Shape a Clay Kettle Mold (28 Clay Balls) at the Mold Bench and fire it, pour 8 units of bronze into it and grind the casting on the Whetstone
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.hide_: Boil Raw Hide, Rabbit Hide or Fish Bones in the kettle. Hide Glue hafts tools in place of Cordage
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tanne: Boil Bark with Scraped Hides in the kettle: 3 Leather from every 2 hides, rain or shine
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.blood: Stand a Bronze Kettle under a Hanging Rack and skin the carcass on it. Scoop the full kettle with a Bronze Bucket
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Saw
Cast a saw blade and assemble a Bronze Saw. Log + Saw makes 4 Planks
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.yew_l: Saw a Yew Rough Log into a Yew Stave with the Bronze Saw, then string it at the Tool Station with Sinew and Leather. Slow to draw, hits hard
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.potte: Build a Potter's Wheel (Planks, Bronze Saw, Bronze Ingot, Cobblestone)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.stora: Throw 4 Clay Balls on the wheel and fire the jar. Sealed, food spoils 4x slower
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.water: Throw 3 Clay Balls on the wheel and fire the jug. Holds 6 pours
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.flowe: Throw 2 Clay Balls on the wheel into an Unfired Flower Pot and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.decor: Throw 4 Clay Balls on the wheel into an Unfired Decorated Pot and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.sherd: Press a Pottery Sherd into a finished Unfired Decorated Pot while it is still on the wheel. Fired, the pot keeps the picture
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.woode: Craft a Wooden Wheel: Planks, Tool Rods, a Bronze Ingot hub and the Bronze Saw
Build a Wheeled Cart from 2 Wooden Wheels, Planks and Tool Rods
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.full_: Load two carcasses onto a Wheeled Cart. It holds 6 room: a light body takes 1, a medium 2, a large 3
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.lives: Lead a cow, sheep, pig or hen to a Wheeled Cart or Wagon and right-click it: it climbs on, tied by its lead
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.stora: Right-click an empty Wheeled Cart with a Chest to mount it: 54 slots on wheels (sneak + right-click)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rope_: Craft 3 Cordage into a Rope Halter. Sneak up to a Wild Horse and feed it grain to earn its trust
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tame_: Halter a Wild Horse that trusts you and keep feeding it until it is tame
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.saddl: Craft a Hide Saddle Blanket (3 Leather, 2 Cordage) for full speed and jumps
Right-click a tamed horse with a Leather Satchel. Two fit, one on each side; sneak + right-click to pack them, shears take them off
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.water: Load and distance tire a horse: it slows, and worn out it lies down. Right-click a tired horse with a Water Bucket, or let it drink in shallow water
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.pack_: Carry a body on your shoulders and right-click a tamed horse: it hangs on the horse's side. Hang one on each side
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.leath: Sew Leather Horse Armor at the Leatherworking Bench (7 Leather, 4 Thread) and dye it as you like
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tame_: Win over a skittish Onager with feed, halter it and keep feeding it until it is tame
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.pack_: Sling Pack Baskets (2 Bark Baskets, Scraped Hide, Cordage) on a tame Onager: it carries your load
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tame_: Tame a Wild Camel like an onager: feed, halter, feed. It carries Pack Baskets and goes twice as far without water
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tribe: Come to a tribe's village or camp rebuilt for the Bronze Age: timber halls on stone footings, thatch, pens and a clay kiln
Come to a tribe's village rebuilt for the Iron Age: taller halls and walls, and a smith at work
Buy Flax Seeds from a village Farmer (trade level 3) and sow them on farmland
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.linen: Ret 4 Flax Stalks in a Clay Water Bucket with a knife into Flax Fiber, then spin it on a Drop Spindle into Linen Thread
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.seed_: Sew a Seed Bag (Leather, Cordage, a copper or bronze ingot ring), fill it with seed and right-click farmland: it sows 3x3
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Breaking Ground
Assemble a Bronze Ard at the Tool Station (Bronze Hoe Head, Bronze Plate, Tool Rod): it tills 3x3 at a time (sneak: one)
Bronze Bucket
Cast a bucket in a Clay Bucket Mold, grind it and fit a Cordage bail at the Tool Station. It never cracks
Reaper
Assemble a Bronze Sickle: it cuts a 3x3 swath of ripe crops or grass in one stroke (sneak to cut one)
Shearer
Cast Bronze Shears and grind them: shear sheep and keep leaves
Bronze Hook
Cast 4 Bronze Fish Hooks in one mold, grind them apart and rig a Bronze Hook Fishing Rod: faster bites, better catches
Fine Needlework
Cast 4 Bronze Needles in one mold. They sew at the Armor Station 8 times as long as a Bone Needle
Tongs
Assemble Bronze Tongs. Held in either hand, molten crucibles and fresh castings don't burn you
Stonemason
Assemble a Bronze Chisel and right-click Stone, Stone Bricks or Sandstone with it to carve it one step further
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.fire_: Crush Brick on the Stone Anvil into Grog, mix Fire Clay from Clay Balls and Grog, and fire it in the kiln at 1100°
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bloom: Build a Bloomery: a Bloomery Hearth with two Bloomery Stacks on it and the top left open
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bog_i: Dig rusty Bog Iron Ore with a shovel from the floors of fen and swamp pools (sometimes river beds)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.iron_: Smelt 4 Raw Iron or 6 Raw Bog Iron with Charcoal in the Bloomery. It needs 1350°: pump the bellows into the hearth
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Bronze Anvil
Fire a Clay Anvil Mold (32 Clay Balls), pour a full crucible of bronze (10 units) into it and grind the casting
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coppe: Lay a Copper Ingot on a Bronze Anvil and strike it 4 times with the Bronze Smithing Hammer: 4 Copper Coins, the money villagers take
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.fire_: Strike 3 Bronze Ingots 6 times on a Bronze Anvil and lay the grate in a Fire Pit or Clay Kiln: longer burn, far less smoke, Charcoal in the pit
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.smith: Cast a hammer head, grind it and assemble a Bronze Smithing Hammer at the Tool Station
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.quarr: Assemble a Bronze Quarry Hammer (Bronze Hammer Head, Bronze Plate, Tool Rod): it breaks stone 3x3, ores crumble to stone
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.wroug: Hammer a hot Iron Bloom 8 times on a Bronze Anvil before it cools: Wrought Iron Ingots and Slag
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.marbl: Mine white Marble with a Bronze Pickaxe, deep under mountains and warm plateaus (y -20 to 40). The Bronze Chisel carves it into Chiseled Marble and Marble Pillars
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.quart: Mine pale, hard Quartzite with a Bronze Pickaxe under mountains (y 0 to 120)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.porph: Mine Red or Green Porphyry with a Bronze Pickaxe: rare small blobs everywhere, red more often under badlands, green under windswept hills
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rapak: Mine spotted Rapakivi Granite with a Bronze Pickaxe, mostly under taiga, birch forests and snowy plains (y 0 to 80)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coast: Mine Coastal Basalt with a Bronze Pickaxe: dark columns stand on Stony Shores, and blobs lie under beaches
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.serpe: Mine rare, mottled green Serpentine with a Bronze Pickaxe, mostly under windswept hills and stony peaks
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.alaba: Mine creamy Alabaster with a Bronze Pickaxe: small blobs in the gypsum under deserts and badlands (y 40 to 90)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.soaps: Carve a mold from Polished Soapstone at the Mold Bench: no firing, and it never cracks however often you cast
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rubbl: Crush Conglomerate on the Stone Anvil into 2 Gravel and a Flint, or Shale into 2 Clay Balls
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.basal: Set a Stone Anvil on 3 Coastal Basalt: the heavy Basalt Anvil crushes in 2 blows instead of 4
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.quart: Build a Whetstone with Quartzite instead of Sandstone: it grinds a Rough Cast head in 2 strokes instead of 4
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rapak: Build a Quern from Rapakivi Granite: it grinds a Grain into Flour in 2 clicks instead of 4
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.alaba: Carve an Alabaster Lamp (5 Alabaster, Plant Fibre), fill it with Tallow or Blubber and light it: the flame shines through the stone, light 15
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.kaoli: Dig rare white Kaolin with a shovel in forests, plains and jungles (it crumbles into 4 Kaolin Clay) and fire the block in the Clay Kiln at 1000°: Charcoal and a bellows. Kaolin Tiles
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.plast: Crush Gypsum on the Stone Anvil and burn the powder in the Clay Kiln at 300°. With 2 Sand and Straw it makes 4 Lime Plaster, no bellows needed
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.slate: Frame Polished Slate with 2 Sticks into a Slate Tablet. Write on it with Chalk in your other hand; sneak-use wipes it clean
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.weath: Bricks left out in the weather age: wet with rain or water they grow Mossy, through frosty winters they turn Cracked. Scrub the moss off with a Pumice Chunk
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.mosai: Set four different polished stones together: 4 Mosaic Tiles. Warm (Jasper, Quartzite, Travertine, Yellow Ochre), cool (Slate, Serpentine, Marble, Soapstone) or checkered (Marble, Alabaster, Alum Shale, Coastal Basalt)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tiled: Shape 2 Clay Balls into an Unfired Roof Tile and fire it in the Clay Kiln at 800°. 3 Fired Roof Tiles lay 4 Tiled Roof, a roof that never burns; pigment colours it
