advancements.mechanical.iron_age.root.de: Work a hot Iron Bloom into Wrought Iron on a Bronze Anvil: the Iron Age begins
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.roasted: Roast Raw Iron or Raw Bog Iron on a Campfire or Fire Pit: roasted ore blooms twice as rich (2 Wrought Iron instead of 1)
Heat a Wrought Iron Ingot to 1100° in a Bloomery or Clay Kiln, choose a pattern (hold sneak-use on the anvil with the hammer and pick on the wheel) and hammer it on a Bronze Anvil before it cools: Iron Plate, Tool Rod or a tool head
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_ha: Forge an Iron Hammer Head and assemble an Iron Smithing Hammer (Leather, Tool Rod): it wears half as fast on hot metal
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_to: Assemble an iron tool at the Tool Station: forged head + Leather + Tool Rod. Iron Pickaxes mine gold, redstone and diamond
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_ar: Rivet Iron Plates onto leather at the Armor Station: the full iron armour, chestplate included
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.charcoa: Stack wood piles, cover them with earth on every side and on top, leave one side open and light it with the Fire Drill. After 5 minutes every piece of firewood is a Charcoal (a rough log two)
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.cementa: Shape a Cementation Pot from Fire Clay and fire it, pack it with 3 Wrought Iron, 2 Charcoal and Soot, and hold it at 1000° in a Bloomery for 6 minutes. Break it open: 3 Blister Steel
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.steel.d: Heat Blister Steel to forging heat and fold it with 6 blows of an Iron Smithing Hammer into a Steel Ingot: the end of the Iron Age
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.steel_t: Forge a steel head from hot Steel Ingots and fit it on a Tool Rod, wedged with an Iron Tool Rod. Steel mines obsidian
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.flint_a: Flint + Steel Plate: a Flint and Steel lights a fire every time
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_be: Plate a Bellows with 2 Iron Plates and an Iron Tool Rod: it pumps twice as hard and the heat holds for 60 s after each pump
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.smithin: Build a Smithing Hearth (7 Fire Brick, an Iron Plate), stock it with Charcoal and light it: iron and steel in its coals heat up and stay hot as long as it burns
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.steel_q: Forge a Steel Hammer Head and assemble a Steel Quarry Hammer (Steel Plate, Iron Tool Rod): every ore a steel pickaxe mines crumbles in its 3x3 face
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.steel_a: Rivet Steel Plates onto leather at the Armor Station: steel armour, between iron and diamond
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.big_fir: Lay a Steel Hearth Ring on a Fire Pit: it grows to 3x3 toward the free side. Burns longer, smokes a tall column, and a tribe's big pit keeps 5x5 chunks loaded and lets two bands visit at once
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.whole_r: Haul a skinned carcass to a burning big Fire Pit and hang it over the fire; take the roast when it is done
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.tool_lo: Sew Tool Loops (Leather, Steel Plate) at the Leatherworking Bench and drop them on a Leather Satchel: three slots that hold only tools
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.steel_f: Sew a Steel-Frame Pack: a 5x5 bag with tool loops, worn on the back
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.gold_ca: Set a Steel Casting Table beside a Clay Kiln at 1100° and lay Gold Ingots on it: they melt and set as ring blanks or a chain
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.jeweler: Lay a blank and a cut gem on a Jeweler's Bench and set the stone with a chisel. Wear it in a ring or neck slot
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.flawles: Set a Flawless gem: its bonus is about four times a plain stone's
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.linen_s: Sew a Linen Seed Bag (Linen Thread, an Iron Plate rim, Leather): it sows 5x5 in one throw
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.jasper_: Jasper strikes sparks off steel like flint: Rough or Polished Jasper + Steel Plate make a Flint and Steel
Mine Galena Ore with a Bronze Pickaxe: heavy grey lead ore, with a little silver in it
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.lead.de: Smelt Raw Galena into a Lead Ingot in the Clay Kiln at 800°: Charcoal gets there without bellows
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.cupella: Press a Lead Ingot into Bone Meal for a Leaded Cupel and fire it at 1000°: the lead soaks away and a Silver Nugget is left
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.silver_: Strike a Silver Ingot (9 Silver Nuggets) 4 times on a Bronze Anvil: 4 Silver Coins, each worth 10 Copper
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.gold.de: Melt Raw Gold, or 9 Gold Nuggets panned from gravel and sand, into a Gold Ingot in the Clay Kiln at 1100°
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.gold_co: Strike a Gold Ingot 4 times on a Bronze Anvil: 4 Gold Coins, each worth 10 Silver
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.flux.de: Crush Limestone on the Stone Anvil into 2 Flux. Right-click the Bloomery Hearth with it: the next bloom gives one more Wrought Iron
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.limesto: Carve Limestone with the Bronze Chisel, or craft 4 Polished Limestone into Limestone Bricks: slabs, stairs and walls like any stone
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.salt.de: Mine Rock Salt with a Bronze Pickaxe, deep under deserts, badlands and savannas
Salt meat or fish: it never spoils. A Scraped Hide and Salt make Leather without the drying rack
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.dolomit: Mine Dolomite, found with Limestone and most in its cliffs, and craft it into Polished Dolomite and Dolomite Bricks. It crushes into Flux too
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.travert: Mine honey-coloured Travertine under rivers, swamps and plains, and cut it into Cut Travertine
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.shell_b: Mine Shell Bank, stone of old seashells, under beaches and shores, and cut it into Cut Shell Bank
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.quickli: Burn Limestone, Dolomite, a Chalk Block, Travertine or Shell Bank in the Clay Kiln at 900° (bellows): Quicklime
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.lime_mo: Slake Quicklime with a bucket of water, mix it with Sand and Gravel: 4 Lime Mortar. 4 bricks' worth of stone and a Mortar lay 8 bricks
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.lime_pl: Mix Slaked Lime, 2 Sand and Straw into 4 Lime Plaster. 8 around a pigment dye it white, black, red or yellow
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.alum.de: Roast Alum Shale in the Clay Kiln at 800° and leach it with a bucket of water: 2 Alum
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.mordant: Mix 2 pigment with an Alum: 4 dye, twice what the pigment gives alone
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.tawed.d: Taw 2 Scraped Hides with one Alum: 2 Leather
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.repoint: Right-click cracked bricks with Lime Mortar: the cracks are filled and the bricks are whole again
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_ri: Craft a Wooden Wheel with 2 Iron Plates: an Iron-Rimmed Wheel
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.wagon.d: Build a Wagon: 4 Iron-Rimmed Wheels, 3 Planks, an Iron Plate and an Iron Tool Rod for the pole
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.wagon_t: Ride or lead tamed horses to the Wagon and right-click it with an empty hand: two go in the yoke. One alone barely moves it; sneak + right-click a horse to unhitch it
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.full_wa: Load 12 room of carcasses on a Wagon with all four places empty: four large bodies, six medium or twelve light
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.wagon_c: Right-click each of a Wagon's four places with a Chest: 108 slots on wheels. Hay Bales feed the team, wooden slabs make seats
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.log_wag: Carry a felled log of up to 4 blocks to a Wagon and right-click the Wagon: it rides on the empty bed. Sneak + right-click to roll it off
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.wagon_t: Stand a Wheeled Cart close behind a Wagon and right-click it with an empty hand: it rolls along as a trailer. Its load weighs on the team
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.mouldbo: Build a Mouldboard Plough: 2 Sticks for the handles, 3 Logs for the beam, an Iron Tool Rod and 2 Iron Plates
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.first_f: Hitch a tamed horse to the Mouldboard Plough, right-click it to lower the share and drive on: a 5-wide strip of rich farmland
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.warp_we: Build a Warp-weighted Loom: 4 Logs for the frame, an Iron Tool Rod for the heddle and 3 Clay Balls for the weights
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.woven_c: Right-click the loom with 3 Wool, Linen or Silk Thread: a Cloth
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.cloth_b: Make a Cloth Bed: 3 Cloth over 3 Straw and 3 Planks. It rests like a furred bed and, unlike straw, lasts
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.silk_cl: Buy Silk Thread from a Trader Caravan and weave it into Silk Cloth
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_sa: Forge a Saw Blade on the anvil (1 hot ingot) and assemble an Iron Saw (Leather, Stick): 900 uses and it saws a log faster. In steel, the Steel Saw: 1600 uses, faster still
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.crossbo: Craft a Crossbow: 2 Iron Plates for the prod, an Iron Tool Rod for the trigger, 2 Sinew for the string and 2 Tool Rods for the stock
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_bo: Forge Bolt Heads on the anvil (1 hot ingot gives 4) and fletch Iron Bolts: 4 damage, they punch through 40% of armour. Crossbow only
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_si: Forge a Sickle Blade on the anvil (1 hot ingot) and assemble an Iron Sickle (Leather, Stick): 900 uses, it reaps 3x3 and ripe grain gives an extra Sheaf 90% of the time
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.steel_s: Forge a Steel Sickle Blade and assemble a Steel Sickle (Leather, Stick): 1600 uses, it reaps a 5x5 swath and every ripe grain crop gives an extra Sheaf
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_to: Forge Tong Arms and rivet them with an Iron Tool Rod and a leather grip: Iron Tongs, 700 uses, hold hot metal as the bronze ones do
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_sm: Forge the small tools: a Chisel Blade for an Iron Chisel (or Steel Chisel), 4 Iron Needles from one ingot, or 4 Iron Fish Hooks for an Iron Hook Fishing Rod (bites 15 s sooner, Luck of the Sea II)
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.iron_qu: Assemble an Iron Quarry Hammer from an Iron Hammer Head, an Iron Plate and a Tool Rod: its 3x3 face takes the ores an iron pickaxe mines
advancements.mechanical.iron_age.steel_h: Forge a Steel Hammer Head and assemble a Steel Smithing Hammer (Iron Tool Rod, Tool Rod): 1200 uses, a quicker blow

advancements.mechanical.gemstones.jasper: Red jasper on cave floors under badlands and desert, y −16 to 80
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.carnel: Orange carnelian on cave floors under the savanna, y 0 to 64
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.chalce: Blue-grey chalcedony on cave floors under the taiga, y −32 to 48
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.bloods: Dark green with red specks, deep down all over the Overworld, y −64 to −16
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.old_fa: Diamond Ore, Emerald Ore and Amethyst Clusters now give Rough gems: cut them on a Lapidary Wheel
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.cut_di: Cut a Rough Diamond on the Lapidary Wheel with Diamond Dust
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.cut_em: Cut a Rough Emerald on the Lapidary Wheel with Garnet Grit
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.cut_am: Cut a Rough Amethyst on the Lapidary Wheel with Flint Grit
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.lapida: Build a Lapidary Wheel (Sandstone, Twine, a Tool Rod and planks). Right-click it with Sand, then 4 times with a soft Rough gem
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.first_: Cut a gem: an abrasive at least as hard as the stone (Mohs) is needed
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.flawed: An abrasive only just hard enough can crack the stone into a Flawed gem. A harder one never does
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.flawle: Cut a Flawless gem: only a harder abrasive than the stone needs can, and fine rough stones from Large Crystals double the odds
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.flint_: Crush Flint on the Stone Anvil into Flint Grit: it cuts quartz, jade, peridot and the pebble gems
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.garnet: Crush Rough Garnet on the Stone Anvil into Garnet Grit: it cuts garnet, topaz, tourmaline, aquamarine and emerald
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.corund: Crush Rough Ruby or Sapphire into Corundum Grit: the only grit hard enough for ruby and sapphire
advancements.mechanical.gemstones.diamon: Crush a Rough Diamond into Diamond Dust: nothing else is hard enough to cut a diamond
advancements.mechanical.folklore.root.de: Eat a Fly Agaric, raw or boiled on a Campfire (Boiled Fly Agaric, no poison): Second Sight shows what is hidden
advancements.mechanical.folklore.small_f: Find a Glimmering Stump in an old or dark forest and right-click it with berries or nuts. Come back the next morning
advancements.mechanical.folklore.above_t: See a Mountain Watcher circling the peaks above height 150 on a clear day. Only believers (or Second Sight) see it
advancements.mechanical.folklore.gift_of: Come close to a Mountain Watcher you can see: once a year it lets a Watcher Feather fall
See a Huldra at the forest edge at night. Only believers see her, and her back is hollow like a rotten tree
advancements.mechanical.folklore.huldra_: Follow the Huldra among the trees until she stops, then right-click her to take her gift. Walk away and you are Lost
advancements.mechanical.folklore.will_o_: See a Will-o'-the-wisp over a bog or in a dark forest at night
advancements.mechanical.folklore.follow_: Follow a light (or a Jungle Spirit Mask) to the end of its trail and find treasure there instead of losing your way
advancements.mechanical.folklore.jungle_: See a Jungle Spirit Mask floating between the jungle trees at night
advancements.mechanical.folklore.spirit_: Find the Spirit Mask a Jungle Spirit Mask sometimes leads to. Worn, it sharpens your sight for the hidden
advancements.mechanical.folklore.tomte.d: See the Tomte that has moved in by your farm (farm 8 or more Farmland and look about at night)
advancements.mechanical.folklore.yule_po: Right-click the Tomte with a bowl of Porridge in the Yule month (Deepwinter). Forget it, and the animals suffer
advancements.mechanical.folklore.heard_t: Hear Näcken play by the rapids on a moonlit night. Do not listen for too long
See Näcken himself, sitting in the water with his fiddle
advancements.mechanical.folklore.nacken_: Give Näcken a coin or meat: once a year he teaches you (Fiddler's Blessing, more luck for three days)
advancements.mechanical.folklore.bog_bod: Kill a Bog Body that has risen from the peat of a Peat Bog at night
advancements.mechanical.folklore.troll_i: Wake a sleeping troll: chop a tree near a mossy stone in the taiga that is not a stone at all
advancements.mechanical.folklore.frost_g: Kill a Frost Giant. It only walks in snowstorms and leaves with them
advancements.mechanical.folklore.frost_h: Take the Frost Heart from a Frost Giant. Placed, the ice around it never thaws
advancements.mechanical.folklore.bergtag: Sleep alone high in the mountains and wake inside the mountain among the Vittra
advancements.mechanical.folklore.dune_wr: See a Dune Wraith in a desert sandstorm. It is after your water
advancements.mechanical.folklore.dune_gl: Strike a Dune Wraith before it steals your water: it scatters into Dune Glass
advancements.mechanical.folklore.fern_fl: Pick a Fern Flower in bloom. The fern opens its golden flower only on summer nights, deep in old forests, and brings luck
advancements.mechanical.folklore.frost_l: Pick a Frost Lily in bloom. It flowers only in winter, in the snow of cold highlands, and shines faintly
